description: "The Astral World—Higher Occult Powers" by Joel Tiffany is a philosophical exploration of Spiritualism and the nature of higher occult powers, written in the early 20th century. The text delves into concepts such as clairvoyance, mediumship, and spirit healing, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of these phenomena within the framework of spiritual progression.
